title: 中国厨房必有的酱④完结·酱油：一滴酱油，晒足一百八十天 | China's Kitchen Sauces P4 · Soy Sauce 🍶
description:
这四瓶酱——老干妈、豆瓣、蚝油、酱油，你家有几瓶？

中国厨房必有的酱 第④集·收官 · 酱油。一滴古法酱油，要晒足约一百八十天。黄豆、面粉、盐水进缸，「春天下曲、夏天成酱、秋天取油」。第一道抽出来的叫「生抽」，色浅味鲜，专门提味；同一缸再晒久些、蒸发上色，就成了「老抽」，红烧上色全靠它。中国人有句老话叫「开门七件事：柴米油盐酱醋茶」——酱，就在其中。一瓶酱油，藏着半部厨房史。从一瓶辣酱到一滴酱油，这，就是中国人的灶台。

A drop of traditionally brewed soy sauce takes about 180 days of sun. Soybeans, flour and brine go into the jar — "culture in spring, paste in summer, oil in autumn." The first draw is light soy (生抽): pale, fresh, for seasoning. Aged and reduced further, the same jar yields dark soy (老抽), which colors red-braised dishes. An old Chinese saying lists the seven daily necessities — firewood, rice, oil, salt, sauce, vinegar, tea — and 酱 is right there. One bottle holds half a kitchen's history. From a jar of chili crisp to a drop of soy — that's a Chinese kitchen.
